10 labels parse with expectedFactsSchema; slice repo/commit match; every cited path exists in the pinned tree; every fact has a citation; 0 problems

notes: Close call repo-546 etherpad: default dbType is dirty (local file); Postgres only via DB_TYPE env, shown in docker-compose.yml. Labeled NEEDS_CONFIGURATION, postgres true. src/package.json lists mongodb/redis/mysql-capable ueberdb2 drivers as optional backends; labeled redis false and no unsupported family.

Close call repo-547 bakerydemo: Redis is optional (REDIS_URL), labeled redis false. Media is on local disk unless AWS_STORAGE_BUCKET_NAME is set (S3), labeled storage true and NEEDS_CONFIGURATION. No dedicated health endpoint, so no healthPath.

Close call repo-548 leantime: .docker/Dockerfile downloads a release tarball (LEAN_VERSION build arg, no default) and copies config from its own directory, so it does not build from the repository root. Labeled NOT_COMPATIBLE for that reason. MySQL is the default DB (supported per mvp-scope.md, but UNSUPPORTED_FAMILIES maps mysql to a rejection, so a disagreement with analysis is possible); pgsql is optional via LEAN_DB_DEFAULT_CONNECTION, labeled postgres false. Scheduler runs inside supervisord in the same container, labeled worker false.

Close call repo-550 ntfy: root Dockerfile copies a prebuilt ntfy binary and has no CMD (needs 'serve'); Dockerfile-build builds from source but is not the default name and also has no CMD. Default state is SQLite/file cache. Labeled NOT_COMPATIBLE, postgres false (optional via database-url).

Close call repo-549 zammad: needs COMMIT_SHA build arg, a multi-process entrypoint (nginx, rails, websocket, scheduler as separate roles), Elasticsearch enabled by default. Labeled NOT_COMPATIBLE, worker true, unsupported [elasticsearch].
Close call repo-543 teslamate: READY; migrations run in entrypoint.sh, MQTT is optional. Required secrets (ENCRYPTION_KEY etc.) treated as vendor-set env, not a compatibility blocker.

repo-544 Kavita: Dockerfile needs prebuilt _output/*.tar.gz and UI/Web/dist (not produced by the Dockerfile) and uses SQLite; NOT_COMPATIBLE. repo-545 remark42 uses BoltDB files on /srv/var; repo-541 profilarr and repo-542 ConvertX use SQLite and volumes; all NOT_COMPATIBLE with unsupported [local-filesystem].
healthPath /ping for remark42 is cited from the Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK only; the route handler was not found in rest.go.
Unsupported family name 'local-filesystem' and 'elasticsearch' follow normalize.ts naming; 'sqlite' is not in UNSUPPORTED_FAMILIES so it was not used.
